newsitem.title: USA: VTX Electronics ends Elcan merger plans.
newsitem.headline: VTX Electronics ends Elcan merger plans.

text.p: VTX Electronics Corp said on Tuesday it terminated its letter of intent to merge with Elcan Technologies Corp, a privately held company.

"Although we worked very hard to consummate the transaction, significant changes to the original letter of intent became requirements of closing which unfortunately rendered the transaction unachievable," said Al Roth, chairman and chief executive.
VTX announced on Oct. 4 that it planned to acquire Elcan for an undisclosed amount.
VTX supplies electronic components and cable products for information system networks and manufactures cable assemblies used in providing connectivity solutions.
